name: Bind wound
description: Bind Wound heals a number of points of damage based on the level of the caster.
blurb: In my youth, I followed armies in the hospital wagons. There were so many of us, acolytes with no powers except the ability to close the wounds of the injured.
notes: Bind wound can be cast outside combat, on a target hero.

name: Bless
description: Bless causes the target to inflict maximum damage.
blurb: I foolishly left the hospital wagons, donning armor and joining the battle. There I supported the troops as well as healed them.
notes: Bless can be cast by a hero that has wand of blesses artifact equipped. The effect of this spell can be replaced by curse. A hero drinking holy water has this effect.

name: Exorcism
description: Exorcism removes all negative spells from a single friendly target.
blurb: Sometimes, the enemy tried to drag down our brave soldiers with their evil enchantments. These kind of spells can bring army to ruin.
notes: Exorcism does not remove the effects of poison, plague or stun.

name: Holy word
description: Holy Word does damage to a single undead or Death creature based on the level of the caster.
blurb: The power of Life concentrated in a single word - it's as good as a sword against those with evil souls.
notes:
Holy word's damage can be affected by the target's Luck modifier or magic resistance. The spell can be used against creatures raised by Animate Dead or Death Call spells. Cannot be used against heroes.
A bottle of Holy Water thrown into an enemy creature acts as this spell.

name: Spiritual armor
description: Spiritual Armor increases its Melee and Ranged Defense of a friendly target by 25%.
blurb: Real armor wears a man down after hours of battle. Something lighter was needed for those of us who were in an inferior physical condition.
notes: Heroes with Prophet class have this ability.

name: Summon ship
description: Summon Ship causes a single ship to appear at the caster's present location on the adventure map.
blurb: I was stranded when they sunk my ship. At least the rain brought fresh water or I might have perished. Unfortunately, it took three weeks before someone found me. Never again!
notes: Summon ship only works when the hero is standing on a tile near water terrain. The boat must be under the player's ownership. This spell is never offered to the hero as a starting spell (at the beginning of a map or when they learn Basic Life Magic skill).

name: Chaos ward
description: The target of a Chaos Ward is 50% resistant to Chaos spells, and their Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Chaos-aligned opponents.
blurb: I buried a friend once who succumbed to a sorcerer's spells after bravely using his own magic to save the people around him first.
notes: Titans, heroes with Monk class or a hero equipped with Order armor artifact have this ability.

name: Death ward
description: The target of a Death Ward is 50% resistant to Chaos spells, and their Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Death-aligned opponents.
blurb: Our greatest and darkest enemy, the necromancers, needs our strongest defense.
notes: Crusaders, monks, heroes with Paladin class, a hero equipped with Life armor artifact or a hero drinking holy water have this ability.

name: Defender
description: Defender increases the Melee and Ranged Defense of all friendly targets by 50% when they are defending against an attack.
blurb: The beauty of defense is if you know what your enemy is up to, then you can respond accordingly. Less chances of mistakes that way.

name: Heal
description: Heal cures a target of a number of Hit Points based on the level of the caster. Heal is also capable of curing Poison and Plague.
blurb: Show me a man who walks into a sick tent with no thought of his own health and I'll show you a brave man.
notes: Heal can be cast outside combat, on a target hero. This spell can be cast by a hero carrying a wand of healing.

name: Heavenly shield
description: Heavenly Shield can only be cast on the caster, giving additional Hit Points based on the caster's level.
blurb: The heavens protect those who serve. Some better than others. And then sometimes you have to protect yourself.
notes: Heavenly shield absorbs the damage the hero would take. The additional Hit Points granted by this effect cannot be healed.

name: Martyr
description: Martyr is cast on a friendly target. All the damage done to a second friendly target will then be transferred to the recipient of the spell. This effect lasts for the entire combat.
blurb: What a beautiful and selfless act for someone to surrender their own life so that another can survive!
notes: The damage depends on the melee, ranged defense or magic resistance of the first target, which is then inflicted on the second target.

name: Mirth
description: Mirth gives the target maximum morale.
blurb: Later in my career, I talked to the troops before I led them into battle. I prayed and explained that their sacrifices would not be forgotten. And they all fought like heroes.
notes: Satyrs and genies can cast this spell. Heroes with Crusader class have this ability. The effect of this spell can be replaced by sorrow.

name: Nature ward
description: The target of a Nature Ward is 50% resistant to Nature spells, and their Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Nature-aligned opponents.
blurb: I led the expedition through the dark woods, all of as protected from the evil magic of the witches who dwelled there.
notes: A hero equipped with Unnatural armor has this ability.

name: Order ward
description: The target of a Order Ward is 50% resistant to Order spells, and their Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Order-aligned opponents.
blurb: Only if we had been able to become allies! We both believed in protecting others. But they still attacked and I had to act to protect my own troops…
notes: A hero equipped with Chaos armor has this ability.

name: Retribution
description: Retribution is cast on a friendly target. When the enemy attacks the target in melee combat, the attacker will take damage based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Pain will be visited upon those who strike me. A holy and righteous pain!

name: Song of Peace
description: Song of Peace causes an enemy target within the line of sight of the caster to become unable to attack or cast spells on the caster's army during the next turn.
blurb: If only a song could end all violence forever, but that is the dream of a young man. I am too old to hope.
notes: The unit can still retaliate against enemy creatures. This spell does not affect undead or mechanical creatures. This spell removes the effect of berserk.

name: Celestial armor
description: Celestial Armor increases the Melee and Ranged Defense of all friendly targets by 25%.
blurb: If we have to fight wars to keep back tide of evil, then we should protect those who fight as best as we can.

name: Holy shout
description: Holy Shout does a number of points of damage based on the level of the caster to all undead and Death creatures.
blurb: Demons and undead - come before me, you aberrant beings! I shall purge the world of your evil. I shall clense the stain of your existance!
notes:
Holy shout's damage can be affected by the target's Luck modifier or magic resistance.
Holy shout affects all undead and Death creatures on the field, including friendly ones, but does not affect heroes.
The spell affects all creatures raised by Animate Dead or Death Call spells.

name: Mass bless
description: Mass Bless causes all friendly targets to do maximum damage.
blurb: An army with a mission, with a common goal, is a strong one. An army with the blessing of the gods is invincible!
notes: The effect of this spell can be replaced by mass curse.

name: Mass healing
description: Mass Healing cures all friendly targets of a number of points of damage based on the level of the caster. It also cures Poison and Plague on all friendly targets.
blurb: As much as it tires me, I never feel better than after I have cured numerous souls of their pain.
notes: Mass healing can be cast outside combat, and it affects all heroes in the army.

name: Regeneration
description: Regeneration causes the target to regenerate a number of Hit Points every turn based on the level of the caster.
blurb: We - every man, woman, and child - are evidence of the incredible power of Life. Cut us and we may bleed. But we heal!
notes:
Regeneration comes to action before Poison and Plague, unless the target has maximum number of Hit Points at the beginning of its turn.
Trolls and a hero wearing ring of regeneration or breastplate of regeneration have this ability.

name: Mass Chaos ward
description: Mass Chaos Ward causes all friendly targets to become 50% resistant to Chaos spells, and increases their Melee and Ranged Defense by 50% against Chaos-aligned opponents.
blurb: Unfortunately, too often the forces of Chaos are used for evil purposes, and they must be guarded against.
notes: A hero equipped with Order shield grants this effect to all other units in the army.

name: Mass Death ward
description: Mass Death Ward causes all friendly targets to become 50% resistant to Death spells, and increases their Melee and Ranged Defense by 50% against Death-aligned opponents.
blurb: More than any force, we must protect ourselves from unnatural powers of Death!
notes: A hero equipped with Life shield grants this effect to all other units in the army.

name: Mass exorcism
description: Mass Exorcism removes all negative spells from friendly targets.
blurb: I am like a father to my troops. I provide for their spirits, and in times of danger I protect them from the dark touch of the enemy.

name: Mass fervor
description: Mass Fervor causes all friendly targets to gain maximum morale.
blurb: The war had already been lost, so what did this battle matter? To save the lives of my soldiers, I had to raise their spirits and fill them with hope.
notes: The effect of this spell can be replaced by mass sorrow.

name: Mass Nature ward
description: Mass Death Ward causes all friendly targets to become 50% resistant to Nature spells, and increases their Melee and Ranged Defense by 50% against Nature-aligned opponents.
blurb: The beasts of Nature are unpredictable, so we need a ward to protect us both.
notes: A hero equipped with Unnatural shield grants this effect to all other units in the army.

name: Mass Order ward
description: Mass Order Ward causes all friendly targets to become 50% resistant to Nature spells, and increases their Melee and Ranged Defense by 50% against Order-aligned opponents.
blurb: I have seen what the self-righteous are capable of, and I rest easier knowing I have a defense against them.
notes: A hero equipped with Chaos shield grants this effect to all other units in the army.

name: Prayer
description: Prayer increases the Hit Points and damage of all Life targets by 25%.
blurb: Guard us, your servants of Life! Protect our bodies, and if we shall fall take us quickly into your warm embrace!
notes: Prayer also affects enemy Life units.

name: Divine intervention
description: Divine Intervention fully heals and removes all curses (including poison) from all friendly targets. Resurrects dead heroes.
blurb: Our commander made a mistake and fell into a trap. Many were injured. Some were dead. Something had to be done, so I raised my hands to the sky and begged for help.
notes: Divine intervention only resurrects dead heroes in combat if there are no units standing over them. This spell can be used outside combat, and it affects all heroes.

name: Guardian angel
description: Guardian Angel gives the friendly target a number of extra lives based on the level of the caster. The number of targets protected depends on the level of the caster, and no target is protected more than once.
blurb: I felt the spirit around me. I couldn't see or hear it, but had the distinct feeling that was my long-departed grandfather. He tickled my knee like he had when I was a child.
notes: A hero drinking a potion of immortality has this effect. This effect is applied when the targeted unit is dead.

name: Sanctuary
description: While under Sanctuary, a friendly target cannot be attacked or affected by spells. No more than one target may be in Sanctuary on each side. If the target takes any action other than "defend", the spell ends.
blurb: I seek only safety and an understanding of the world.
notes: Sanctuary is not removed if a unit moves or waits for a turn. It cannot be removed with dispel/mass dispel or cancellation/mass cancellation spells.

name: Blur
description: Blur obscures a target's true position, increasing its Ranged Defense by 50%.
blurb: A good archer has steady hands and keen eyesight. The hands are remarkably difficult to influence, unlike the eyes, which sit there at the front of the mind.
notes: Blur can be cast by mages. Heroes with Shadow Mage class have this ability.

name: Dispel
description: Dispel removes all spells, both beneficial and harmful, from the target. It has no effect on Poison or Plague.
blurb: Deconstruction is the basis of all study. You must know a thing's parts before you can know the sum of those parts. And thus, dispelling even that which we cannot cast becomes simple.
notes: Dispel, when cast on a summoned unit, removes it. This spell ignores magic resistance. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature. An army with a hero equipped with ring of permanency artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Displacement
description: Displacement causes the target to move 2 yards in a direction of the caster's choice, if possible.
notes: The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Magic fist
description: Magic Fist does a number of points of damage based on the level of the caster to a single target within the line-of-sight of the caster.
blurb: A strong defense is paramount to one's survival, but battles cannot be won by defense alone. So when the time comes strike hard and fast.
notes: Magic fist's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Battle Mage class. It can be cast by mages.

name: Precision
description: Precision increases the target's Ranged Attack by 25%, and also gives the target no penalty for range, walls or obstacles.
blurb: Firing aimlessly into the enemy is a tactic used too often by foolish commanders. Why leave to chance what you can control?
notes: Precision is a mind spell. Two obstacles still give penalty to creature's ranged attack with this effect.

name: Visions
description: Visions shows you the exact number of troops in an army on the adventure map and reveals the skills of an enemy hero.
blurb: Unfortunately, scouting reports of one's enemy are not always accurate. A set of checks and balances are necessary for victory.
notes: Visions is only cast on the adventure map, it cannot be cast in battles.

name: Cowardice
description: Cowardice makes the target unable to attack an enemy with more total hit points for 3 turns.
blurb: Weaker units wisely team up against a single, stronger opponent, overwhelming them. To counter that, you must keep them off your back.
notes: Cowardice is a mind spell. A unit with this effect cannot target enemy creatures that have more total hit points with spells. The unit can still retaliate against such creatures. It can be cast by genies. It is inflicted by evil eyes. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Create illusion
description: Create Illusion forms a duplicate stack of creatures with a number of hit points based on the level of the caster. The illusion vanishes after combat ends.
blurb: If the mind believes something is real then it is real in every sense of the word - exept that it still may not have physical form.
notes: Creatures summoned by create illusion are immune to mind spells, as well as healing spells (bind wound, heal, mass healing, divine intervention and resurrection). If cast twice on the same creature unit, the same unit has additional units (the spell does not create two separate units). If this spell is cast on a spellcasting unit, the summoned creature does not have mana points. If this spell is cast on a ranged unit, the first unit gains ammo shots, but casting it twice does not replenish them. This spell cannot target creatures immune to magic. If the hero casts town portal spell in battle, the summoned creatures remain to battle, and if victorious, the retreating hero receives no experience. This spell's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Illusionist class. It can be cast by genies and a hero with wand of illusions artifact equipped.

name: Flight
description: Flight grants a friendly target the ability to fly until the end of combat.
blurb: The longer a siege, the worse it is for the attacker. So, ways must be created to topple a defender. Nothing surprises them more than flying right over their walls.
notes: Flight not only allows a unit to fly over obstacles, but also effectively increases their movement range by 50%. Battle mechanics let flying units move over Movement × 3 squares, while non-flying ones with an equal movement attribute can move over Movement × 2 squares.

name: Ice bolt
description: Ice Bolt does a number of points of cold damage based on the level of the caster to a single target within the line of sight of the caster.
blurb: Someone was needed to counteract the seering fire attacks favored by Chaos spellcasters.
notes: Ice bolt's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Battle Mage class. It can be cast by genies, water elementals and a hero that has wand of ice artifact equipped. This spell does not affect water elementals and ice demons.

name: Power drain
description: Power drain causes the target's spells to cost double the normal spell points.
blurb: In magical battles, the conservation of mana is everything! He who can cast the last spell will be victorious.
notes: The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Slow
description: Slow causes the enemy target to move at half speed and movement.
blurb: When a charging enemy suddenly feels a tremendous weight on his back, he can only slow his pace to compensate even if there is nothing there to explain this unusual heaviness.
notes: Slow does not stack with fatigue spell. The effect of this spell can be replaced by haste and speed spells. It can be cast by genies. It is inflicted by evil eyes. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Steal enchantment
description: Steal Enchantment removes a beneficial spell from an enemy target and places it on a random friendly target.
blurb: Once a magical energy has been cast, it is suprisingly simple to transfer its area of focus to another.
notes: Steal enchantment also affects other abilities, such as the ones granted by potions. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature. An army with a hero equipped with with ring of permanency artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Banish
description: Banish destroys a number of summoned creatures based on the caster's skill.
blurb: Where do they go? There are two schools of thoughts in this area. Some believe the banished creature is cast into oblivion - dies. Other more sensible thinkers believe they simple return from whence they came.
notes: Banish can only target enemy summoned creatures.

name: Forgetfulness
description: Forgetfulness restrains an enemy target from using ranged attacks for the duration of the combat.
blurb: Ranged troops can easily turn the tide of battle, that is, unless you take them out of the equation.
notes: Forgetfulness is a mind spell. It is inflicted by evil eyes. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature. An army with a hero equipped with crystal of memory artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Mass blur
description: Mass Blur obscures the true position of all friendly targets, increasing their Ranged Defense by 50%.
blurb: A good archer has steady hands and keen eyesight. The hands are remarkably difficult to influence, unlike the eyes, which sit there at the front of the mind.

name: Mass dispel
description: Mass Dispel removes all spells from all targets.
blurb: Efforts to increase the power of Dispel resulted in a power that, unfortunately, cannot be directed. Nonetheless, it is quite effective.
notes: Mass dispel also removes all summoned creatures. An army with a hero equipped with with ring of permanency artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Mass precision
description: Mass Precision increases the Ranged Attack of all friendly ranged targets by 25%, and also gives the target no penalty for range, walls or obstacles.
blurb: Of course, nothing is a substitute for extensive training, but sometimes you are forced to work with inexperienced troops.
notes: Mass precision is a mind spell.

name: Teleport
description: Teleport instantly moves the target to another designated point on the battlefield.
blurb: A true testiment to the power of experimentation! As a result of extensive study of the magical portals around the land, this spell was finally created, although in a limited form.
notes: The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Town gate
description: Town Gate transports the caster and accompanying army to the nearest of the towns they control.
blurb: This spell requires a predetermined destination or else the caster will become lost in the cosmos forever, and unfortunately the only safe spot is a town under your control.
notes: Town gate teleports the hero to the closest town on the level (surface or underground) they are standing on. If the town has armies standing in front of the entrance, that the hero cannot be transported to that town. This spell can be cast outside combat.

name: Berserk
description: Berserk forces the target to attack the nearest creature or hero, whether friend or foe.
blurb: One scholar's study of anger in a Barbarian culture resulted in a fascinating discovery that proves useful in battle.
notes: Berserk is a mind spell. It can also be cast on friendly creature units. This effect is not removed if the affected creature kills a unit in one blow. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Blind
description: Blind causes an enemy target within the line of sight of the caster to become unable to take an action for 3 rounds. It is dispelled if the target takes damage.
blurb: Creatures that never had eyes in the first place, like the troglodyte, are immune to Blind.
notes: Blind can sometimes be inflicted by unicorns. A hero equipped with crown of enchantment artifact can cast this spell on creatures immune to this effect. Troglodytes and an army with a hero equipped with helm of seeing artifact are immune to this effect.

name: Mass slow
description: Mass Slow causes all non-immune enemy targets to move at half speed and movement.
blurb: The muscles become like rubber and the lungs constrict to allow in far less air. The result is an enemy army that is tired, sluggish, and easier to defeat.
notes: The effect of this spell can be replaced by mass speed spell.

name: Phantom image
description: Phantom Image creates a duplicate of a single creature. The strength of the image depends on the caster's level.
blurb: It is just an illusion, a figment of light and imagination. But it is so thoroughly convincing that people have been known to smell it's illusionary sweat.
notes: The effects of phantom image are the same as create illusion, but with higher potency. If there is an existing unit summoned by create illusion, this spell adds more creatures to that unit, instead of creating a separate unit, and vice versa. This spell's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Illusionist class.

name: Hypnotize
description: Hypnotize brings the target under the caster's control for 3 turns.
blurb: The mind is surprisingly weak and open to suggestion, especially the mind of your average soldier, so why not take advantage of it?
notes: Hypnotize is a mind spell. It can sometimes be inflicted by mermaids. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature. Blessing spells can be cast on the creature with this effect.

name: Pain mirror
description: Pain Mirror causes half the damage done to a friendly target to be done to the attacker as well. The reflected damage cannot exceed the hit points of the target.
blurb: Efforts to turn all damage back to its origin failed, so we had to settle on a sort of balanced retribution… for now.
notes: Pain mirror inflicts damage to units that performed a melee or ranged attack.

name: Steal all enchantments
description: Steal All Enchantments causes all beneficial enchantments on enemy targets to be removed and distributed randomly among friendly targets.
blurb: With a single spell, we can assure that our forces have advantage over our enemy. Now, that is the model of efficiency!
notes: An army with a hero equipped with ring of permanency artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Cancellation
description: Cancellation removes all beneficial spells from the target.
blurb: The knights spent a full day preparing for their attack, praying, casting spells, and polishing their armor. Pointless! But at least they died in shiny armor.
notes: Cancellation ignores magic resistance. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature. This spell is inflicted by evil eyes. This spell destroys creatures summoned with create illusion and phantom image spells. An army with a hero equipped with ring of permanency artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Curse
description: Curse causes the target to do minimum damage in combat.
blurb: May your hair fall out and grow boils on your nose, limp with the gout and lose all your clothes. A hex on you!
notes: Curse is inflicted by mummies and evil eyes. It can be cast by mages and a hero that has wand of curses artifact equipped. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature. The effect of this spell can be replaced by bless.

name: Disrupting ray
description: Disrupting Ray decreases the target's Melee and Ranged Defense by 20%.
blurb: I put this on a young knight once without him knowing it. He stupidly stood toe-to-toe with a skeleton thinking he could easily beat it. Boy, was he ever wrong!
notes: Disrupting ray is inflicted by evil eyes. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Poison
description: Poison damages the target every round (starting with the current round) until combat ends.
blurb: You have to agree , there is nothing quite as appealing as gloating over your enemy as they die ever so slowly.
notes: Mages can cast this spell. It is inflicted by venom spawn, heroes with Ninja class, or a hero wearing Ring of the Cobra's Eye. It is also inflicted by a hero equipped with poison arrow artifact, but only for ranged attacks. It cannot be removed with dispel or exorcism spells, but it can be removed with heal or divine intervention spells. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Raise skeletons
description: Raise a number of Skeletons based on the caster's level from any stack of dead creatures.
blurb: Otherwise, the bones go to waste, don't they?
notes: Mages can cast this spell. It cannot target creatures with necromancy ward spell, including a dead stack.

name: Animate dead
description: Animate dead raises a number of creatures, based on the caster's level, from any stack with dead creatures. Animated creatures vanish after combat ends.
blurb: There is no greater way to convince your enemy that your army is invincible than tropps that refuse to stay dead.
notes: Animate dead spell cannot target creatures with necromancy ward spell, including a dead stack. This spell can target dead mechanical and elemental creatures. The summoned creature is treated as undead. It can be cast by a hero that has wand of animate dead artifact equipped. This spell cannot target creatures immune to magic.

name: Fatigue
description: Fatigue causes the enemy target to move at half speed and movement in combat. It only affects living creatures.
blurb: Keep the enemy away as long as you can, and pick them off one at a time. One-on-one battle is for fools and knights!
notes: Fatigue does not stack with slow spell. This is a mind spell. The effect of this spell can be replaced by haste and speed spells. It is cast by water elementals. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Life drain
description: Life Drain steals Hit Points from all Life and Nature targets, and then the caster gains a portion of the total Hit Points drained.
blurb: Their life energy may be pure and tasteless, but it sure feels good!

name: Mire
description: Mire causes the target army to move at half speed on the Adventure Map during its next turn.
blurb: There is always a bigger fish, so if you run into one it is always good to have an escape plan.
notes: Mire is only cast on the adventure map, it cannot be cast in battles.

name: Sorrow
description: Sorrow gives the target maximum negative morale.
blurb: Why are you fighting? You have no chance of winning. You barely know how to lift a sword, much less use it! Why not give up?
notes: Sorrow also decreases enemy target unit's damage by 20%. This is a mind spell. It is inflicted by heroes with the Dark Lord class and evil eyes. The effect of this spell can be replaced by mirth spell. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Unholy song
description: Unholy Song causes all Life targets to do 20% less damage and decreases their Melee and Ranged Defense by 20%.
blurb: I've seen monks try to cover their ears when they hear these haunting notes, but they just don't understant that your soul doesn't need ears to hear.
notes: A hero equipped with Aiffe's mandolin artifact can cast this spell. [风暴聚集]

name: Weakness
description: Weakness causes the target to do 25% less damage in combat.
blurb: Most of those heroic types rely on their muscles to settle their problems. Sometimes, those muscles can give you problems!
notes: Weakness can be replaced by bloodlust spell. It is inflicted by waspworts and evil eyes. It can be cast by water elementals. It can be cast by a hero that has wand of weakness artifact equipped. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Aura of fear
description: Aura of Fear is cast on a friendly unit, and prevents enemies from retaliating against the subject's attacks unless they are immune to Death, Fear or Mind spells.
blurb: They don't understand it, but their arms go rubbery and their throats constrict. Suddenly, I am their greatest fear, I love it!
notes: Aura of fear is a mind spell. This spell cannot be cast on sprites, vampires, cerberi, harpies, nagas, hydras, bone dragons and a hero equipped with hideous mask artifact. An army with a hero equipped with badge of courage artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Magic leech
description: Magic leech causes any spell cast by the target to cost double the Spell Points. Also, the caster of Magic Leech gains 1 Spell Point per 2 Spell Points used by target.
blurb: This will make that sorcerer think twice about casting Lightning Bolt!

name: Mass cancellation
description: Mass cancellation removes all beneficial spells from all enemy targets.
blurb: Their leader was cutting through my troops with his glowing sword. He was so laden with enchantments that we couldn't touch him. And then my necromancer finally joined the fray.
notes: An army with a hero equipped with ring of permanency artifact is immune to this effect.

name: Mass curse
description: Mass Curse causes all enemy targets to do minimum damage in combat.
notes: Mass curse can be replaced by mass bless spell.

name: Plague
description: Plague causes all targets on the Combat Map, friend or foe, to come down with a deadly, damaging disease. It has no effect on non-living or Death targets.
blurb: Sickness always cripples an army, unless that army is already dead.
notes: Plague cannot be removed with dispel or exorcism spells, but it can be removed with heal or divine intervention spells.

name: Raise ghost
description: Raise a number of Ghosts based on the level of the caster from any stack of dead creatures. The number of raised Ghosts cannot exceed either the Hit Points or number of the creatures. All Ghosts vanish after combat ends.
blurb: Trap their spirits to fight for you before they can flee the battlefield.
notes: Raise ghost spell cannot target creatures with necromancy ward spell, including a dead stack.

name: Death call
description: Death Call targets a friendly or enemy target with dead creatures, raising a number of creatures based on the caster's level. These raised creatures are placed under the control of the caster and vanish after combat.
blurb: The Undead attacked us from the rear! But only our own dead were behind us…
notes: Death call spell cannot target creatures with necromancy ward spell, including a dead stack. The summoned creature is treated as undead. This spell cannot target creatures immune to magic.

name: Mass sorrow
description: Mass Sorrow causes all enemy targets to have maximum negative morale.
blurb: I was on a wall when sieging army threw down their weapons and turned away. Some of them were weeping. The battle was over - for them.
notes: Mass sorrow can be replaced by mass fervor spell. This is a mind spell. Mass sorrow also decreases enemy units' damage by 20%.

name: Mass weakness
description: Mass Weakness causes all enemy targets to do 25% less damage in combat.
blurb: Endurance and strength are important in battle. The army that weakens first usually loses. I just help it along a little.
notes: Mass weakness can be replaced by bloodfrenzy spell.

name: Vampiric touch
description: Vampiric Touch causes a friendly target to gain 1 Hit Point for every 2 Hit Points of damage they inflict in melee combat to living enemies.
blurb: Everyone loves vampires, and sometimes they want to know what's it's like to be one.
notes: Vampires, a hero with the soul stealer artifact equipped, and heroes with Dark Priest class have this ability.

name: Hand of Death
description: Hand of Death instantly kills a number of opponents in line of sight, based on the level of the caster.
blurb: What does it feel like when my hand closes tightly around your heart? It tries to beat, but your heart is under my control now!
notes: Hand of Death, when failing to beat magic resistance, does not kill any creature. It can be cast by a hero that has deadwood staff artifact equipped. This spell cannot be cast on mechanical, undead or elemental creatures.

name: Raise vampires
description: Raise a number of Vampires based on the level of the caster from a stack of dead creatures.
blurb: There's too much blood in the world anyway!
notes: Raise vampires spell cannot target creatures with necromancy ward spell, including a dead stack.

name: Sacrifice
description: Sacrifice one friendly stack of your choosing to return life to another.
blurb: The lives of my troops are there for taking, to be used how I best see fit.
notes: Sacrifice cannot target summoned creatures.

name: Bloodlust
description: Bloodlust causes the friendly target to do 25% more damage in melee combat for the duration of the battle.
blurb: The fury is like fire in my veins! Burning...hot...RAGE! Die!
notes: Bloodlust is a mind spell. It is cast by ogre magi. Heroes with Reaver class have this ability.

name: Fire aura
description: Fire Aura causes the friendly target to do minor fire damage in addition to its normal melee combat damage.
blurb: Great in battle! Just don't walk too close to the drapes.
notes: Efreet, fire elementals, phoenixes and heroes with Fireguard class are immune to the effects of this spell. This spell's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Fire Diviner class. A hero equipped with flaming sword artifact has this ability.

name: Haste
description: Haste gives the friendly target plus 3 to their speed and plus 3 yards to their movement.
blurb: Strike before they know happened! If you can move farther and faster than your enemy, you have won half the battle.
notes: Haste can be replaced by slow or fatigue spells. Heroes with Assassin class have this ability. It can be cast by a hero equipped with wand of haste artifact.

name: Magic arrow
description: Magic Arrow casts a burst of magical energy that does damage to a single target within the line of sight of the caster.
blurb: Straight as an...well, an arrow! And a lot easier to hit your target than with a real bow.

name: Slayer
description: Slayer causes the friendly target to do 50% more damage against 4th level creatures.
blurb: This is the secret behind all these silly knights who have slain dragons.
notes: A hero equipped with the giant slayer artifact has this ability, but only for melee attacks. A hero equipped with arrow of slaying artifact has this ability, but only for ranged attacks.

name: Sparks
description: Sparks casts a spray of magical energy that does damage to anyone in the three spaces in front of the caster.
blurb: You wait, let them get right up to you. And then you make them pay for it!

name: Confusion
description: Confusion causes an enemy target within the line of sight of the caster to lose its next action.
blurb: Catch someone trying to figure out if they want to hit you, or cast a spell, or defend themselves and bang! You got them.
notes: Confusion is a mind spell. It is cast by faerie dragons.

name: Fire bolt
description: Fire Bolt is a powerful attack that does fire damage to a single target within the line of sight of the caster.
blurb: Set your enemies on fire, light a campfire, or roast a duck - it's an all purpose spell!
notes: Efreet, fire elementals, phoenixes and heroes with Fireguard class are immune to the effects of this spell. This spell's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Fire Diviner class. It can be cast by a hero equipped with wand of fire artifact.

name: First strike
description: First Strike grants a friendly target the First Strike ability for the duration of the combat.
blurb: In any fight, getting the first hit usually assures that you'll get the last hit too.
notes: White tigers, mantises, dragon golems, champions and nomads have this ability.

name: Mana flare
description: Mana Flare reduces the spell costs for all heroes and creatures (friend and foe alike) by 2.
blurb: Who wants to worry about their mana? In battle, I'm busy throwing spells like mad, so I could always use a little boost.
notes: If a spell's cost is 2 or less, mana flare ability sets it to 1. As an additive effect, it follows all similar multiplicative effects: other effects of spell mana cost reduction will be applied first, and then mana flare.

name: Misfortune
description: Misfortune gives a single enemy target maximum bad luck.
blurb: Yeah, you can use it in battle, but do you want to know where it's REALLY useful? The gambling table.
notes: Misfortune can be replaced by fortune spell. It is inflicted by heroes with Wizard King class, but only by a melee attack, or a hero equipped with fizbin of misfortune artifact. The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature.

name: Spell shackle
description: Spell Shackle causes the enemy spellcaster to take damage for every Spell Point they use during combat.
blurb: Negative reinforcement works! If it hurts, you're likely to stop casting spells.
notes: The hero can cast this spell even if they cannot see the enemy creature. Chaos damage modifiers do not affect this spell's damage.

name: Bloodfrenzy
description: Bloodfrenzy causes all friendly targets to do 25% more damage in melee combat.
blurb: Give me an army of wide-eyed maniacs any day! The killing just doesn't end until the frenzy fades, or everyone is dead.
notes: Bloodfrenzy is a mind spell.

name: Fire ring
description: Fire ring creates a ring of flames around a target within the line of sight of the caster that causes fire damage to all targets within a 1 yard radius surrounding that target.
blurb: Lure them in, let them surround you. That's when they think you're weak. Boy, are they wrong!
notes: Fire ring is cast by faerie dragons. Efreet, fire elementals, phoenixes and heroes with Fireguard class are immune to the effects of this spell. This spell's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Fire Diviner class.

name: Fireball
description: Fireball causes a 3x3 yard explosion of flames a round a target within the line of sight of the caster, doing fire damage to all targets within its blast.
blurb: As far as I'm concerned, there is no other spell. This one has it all.
notes: Fireball is cast by faerie dragons. Efreet, fire elementals, phoenixes and heroes with Fireguard class are immune to the effects of this spell. This spell's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Fire Diviner class. It can be cast by a hero equipped with wand of fireballs artifact.

name: Lightning
description: Lightning summons a powerful bolt of electricity that does damage to a single target within the line of sight of the caster.
blurb: Too bad every creature doesn't burn. In a perfect world, all you need is a fire spell. But just in case I keep this one ready to surprise them.
notes: Lightning is cast by faerie dragons. It is inflicted by thunderbirds and a hero with thunder hammer artifact equipped. This spell's damage can be affected by the target's Luck modifier.

name: Magic mirror
description: Magic Mirror reflects any hostile spell back against its caster at 1/2 strength. The hostile spell still affects its initial target.
blurb: Walk a mile in a man's shoes, even if those shoes are all that's left of him.
notes: If the unit with magic mirror ability is killed, the effect is not applied. This ability also works if the spell is applied through a melee or ranged attack. If a hostile spell that affects multiple creatures is cast (as well as on the unit with this ability), only the caster is affected. Faerie dragons and a hero equipped with mirror of revenge artifact have this ability.

name: Mass slayer
description: Mass Slayer causes all friendly targets to do 50% more damage against 4th level creatures.
blurb: You simply need something to even out the odds. This is as good as anything.

name: Cat reflexes
description: Cat Reflexes gives a friendly target one extra attack.
blurb: Hey, I just sit back here casting spells! Those minotaurs are out there kicking butt. Swinging that axe once is murder, but twice is nicer.

name: Cloud of confusion
description: Cloud of Confusion causes all enemy targets within a 3x3 yard radius to lose their next action. The target must be within the line of sight of the caster.
blurb: This one sure came in handy when I had to escape from he city guard once.

name: Implosion
description: Implosion is an extremely powerful magical attack directed at a single target within the line of sight of the caster.
blurb: I've seen the agony on the faces of my targets. The pain must be incredible. Glad it's not me!
notes: Implosion's damage can be affected by the target's Luck modifier.

name: Inferno
description: Inferno causes fire damage to all targets within a 5x5 yard area. The initial target must be within the line of sight of the caster.
blurb: It has been known to get so hot inside an Inferno strike that it turns sand into glass!
notes: Efreet, fire elementals, phoenixes and heroes with Fireguard class are immune to the effects of this spell. This spell's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Fire Diviner class.

name: Mass first strike
description: Mass First Strike gives all friendly targets the First Strike ability for the duration of the combat.
blurb: I've won battles where the enemy didn't get the chance to attack. Not once! And no, I'm not going to tell you how I did it.

name: Mass misfortune
description: Mass Misfortune causes all enemy targets to suffer from maximum bad luck.
blurb: I make best use of this at gladiatorial events. Somehow, I am always able to pick the winners. Lucky, I guess.
notes: Mass misfortune can be replaced by mass fortune spell.

name: Armageddon
description: Armageddon summons a deadly magical storm that does damage to all targets on the Combat Map.
blurb: I know it's going to hurt, but winning is the important thing. And if my troops die, well, better them than me!

name: Chain lightning
description: Chain Lightning does full damage to the first target it strikes, then strikes a second target for 1/2 damage, a third for 1/4 damage, a fourth for 1/8 damage and a fifth for 1/16 damage.
blurb: When your hair stands on end, you are already dead.
notes: This spell selects the closest friendly or enemy targets, but does not affect the same target twice.

name: Disintegrate
description: Disintegrate is an extremely powerful magical attack directed at a single target within the line of sight of the caster. Targets killed by the Disintegrate spell cannot be raised or resurrected until combat ends.
blurb: This is the final word. You are dead! You're not coming back. And I can do it again, so you better run.
notes: Disintegrate's damage can be affected by the target's Luck modifier.

name: Pathfinding
description: Pathfinding grants an army no movement penalty on the Adventure Map.
blurb: It was going to be a surprise attack. No one was close enough to stop our raid. But when we got to the elf town, we found a thousand soldiers waiting.
notes: Pathfinding cannot be cast during combat. A hero equipped with boots of explorers artifact has this ability.

name: Speed
description: Speed increases a friendly target's speed and movement by 3.
blurb: Something flashed at the edge of my vision. I turned. Nothing but trees. There it was again! Little did I know that this would continue for hours before I left the forest.
notes: Speed can be replaced by fatigue or slow spells. This spell does not stack with the haste spell.

name: Stoneskin
description: Stoneskin increases the target's Melee and Ranged Defense by 25%.
blurb: Then the druid put two pebbles in his mouth. Was he mad? I soon found out why as his skin hardened, turning instead the same color and texture as granite.
notes: Gargoyles have this ability.

name: Summon sprite
description: Summon a number of sprites based on the level of the caster.
blurb: At conjunctions of Nature and magic, the beautiful sprite is born beneath the petals of a flower under the light of the full moon.

name: Summon wolf
description: Summon a number of wolves based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Wolves are the soldiers of Nature. They instinctively understand rank, and they already hunt in highly organized goups under the command of their strongest member.
notes: Summon wolf's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Beastmaster or Beast Lord class.

name: Summon leprechaun
description: Summon a number of leprechauns based on the level of the caster.
blurb: The leprechaun is a creature so in tune with the forces of luck that he is capable of passing some of it off to the people around him.

name: Terrain walk
description: Terrain Walk gives the target the ability to walk on all terrains without penalty during combat.
blurb: Each step through the muddy bog felt like twenty. By the time we reached the enemy, we were exhausted. But the elves, they were still fresh and moving about without any trouble. How?

name: Fortune
description: Fortune grants the target maximum luck.
blurb: If there's one thing I've learned over the years, it's never gamble with an elf. I don't know how they do it, but if you put your gold down, it's as good as gone.
notes: Fortune can be replaced by misfortune spell. It is cast by leprechauns. Heroes with Bard class have this ability.

name: Giant strength
description: Giant Strength increases the target's Hit Points and damage by 25%.
blurb: She was a little old woman. No one expected any trouble from her. Before we knew it, three of us had broken arms!
notes: Giant strength can be cast on a unit with dragon strength spell applied.

name: Quicksand
description: Create a patch of Quicksand, the size of which is based on the caster's level. All targets require a full turn to move through 2 feet of quicksand.
blurb: I refuse to fight an enemy who has the ground itself at their command! War is about gaining strategic ground, but what do you do when the enemy changes the rules of Nature?
notes: Water elementals can cast this spell. Creatures with terrain walk ability are immune to this spell.

name: Snake strike
description: Snake Strike gives the target the First Strike ability. This spell does not stack with the first strike spell.
blurb: Our commander faced the elven swordsman one-on-one. There was no way that puny woodsman could beat him. But in a flash, the elf struck and our captain fell dead without drawing his blade.

name: Summon elf
description: Summon a number of elves based on the level of the caster.
blurb: The regal, artistic elf is one of the oldest living races. Perhaps their ability to live peacefully with their environment is one of the reasons they have survived while other races have died out.

name: Summon satyr
description: Summon a number of satyrs based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Life is an endless party for the carefree satyr. It is said that if a satyr were to become depressed it would kill him as certain as any blade.

name: Summon white tiger
description: Summon a number of white tigers based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Every white tiger possesses the wisdom of its entire race. Even though they are fiercely independent creatures, the bond between them is unbreakable and they take great joy in spending time with the others of their kind.
notes: Summon white tiger's power can be additionally boosted if the hero is of Beast Lord class.

name: Wasp swarm
description: Wasp Swarm summons a cloud of wasps that distract the enemy target for one round. It has no influence on undead or mechanical creatures.
blurb: It was like a black cloud, a buzzing and stinging cloud! I ran. If not for that pool, I don't know what I would've done.

name: Anti-magic
description: Anti-Magic makes the target immune to all spells for the duration of the combat.
blurb: Our sorcerer threw everything he had at that druid. Nothing worked! Not even that Fireball that wiped out the rest of the druid's army.

name: Mass speed
description: Mass Speed increases the speed and movement of all friendly targets by 3.
blurb: They came at us so fast we barely had time to react. Elves and wolves and tigers seemed to be everywhere! How can they expect us to win against such odds?
notes: Mass speed can be replaced by mass slow spell.

name: Necromancy ward
description: Necromancy ward prevents any Raise or Animate Dead spell from working for the duration of the combat. It affects all targets on the Combat Map, including dead ones.
blurb: Our graves and tombs must be safe from the disgusting grasp of the necromancers!

name: Summon air elemental
description: Summon a number of air elementals based on the level of the caster.
blurb: How can something made only of air hurt you? Easy. Air elementals are creatures capable of manipulating every particle in the air and conjuring bolts of lightning out of clear sky.
notes: Summon air elemental's power can be additionally boosted if the hero has Ring of the Elementals artifact equipped.

name: Summon earth elemental
description: Summon a number of earth elementals based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Rock and soil are not as permanent as they seem. Over time - decades - centuries, they change shape, erode and move about. Earth elementals can do all that in seconds.
notes: Summon earth elemental's power can be additionally boosted if the hero has Ring of the Elementals artifact equipped.

name: Summon fire elemental
description: Summon a number of fire elementals based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Anyone who has witnessed a forest fire understands that it has a life of its own. These are the furious fire elementals, just as much a force of Nature as any river but much less predictable.
notes: Summon fire elemental's power can be additionally boosted if the hero has Ring of the Elementals artifact equipped.

name: Summon water elemental
description: Summon a number of water elementals based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Water is the most powerful force in the universe. It is capable of crumbling a mountain or digging great canyons. And the water element is no different. Surprisingly, it is the most destructive of the elementals.
notes: Summon water elemental's power can be additionally boosted if the hero has Ring of the Elementals artifact equipped.

name: Mass fortune
description: Mass Fortune gives all friendly targets maximum luck.
blurb: Everything went their way. That's why we lost! Our weapons slipped from sweaty hands. We tripped on rocks. The normal mistakes that happened in battle. But our enemy had no such troubles.
notes: Mass fortune can be replaced by mass misfortune spell.

name: Mass snake strike
description: Mass Snake Strike gives all friendly targets the First Strike ability. This spell does not stack with the mass first strike spell.
blurb: Their warriors struck with such uncanny speed, startling our troops. We were unable to retaliate. I knew once our initiative was lost, the battle was lost too.

name: Summon griffin
description: Summon a number of griffins based on the level of the caster.
blurb: The griffin is a warlike creature that has been used in armies during all recorded history. They are loyal like a faithful dog, but fierce like a rabid wolf.

name: Summon unicorn
description: Summon a number of unicorn based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Haughty and elusive, the unicorn believes it is the grandest creature ever created, and thus it feels responsible for the lives of those poor lesser beings of the forest.

name: Summon waspwort
description: Summon a number of waspworts based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Native to this new world, the waspwort is a feared denizen of nature because it has no sense of morality, only an instinct to survive and consume.

name: Dragon strength
description: Dragon Strength increases the target's Hit Points and damage by 100%.
blurb: It was a sure bet! A barehanded elf versus an ogre. No contest! But curse elves and their magic for that skinny little man humiliated his opponent.
notes: Dragon strength can be cast on a unit with giant strength spell applied.

name: Summon faerie dragon
description: Summon a number of faerie dragons based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Any forest under the protection of a faerie dragon is a calm and magical place, one best left alone if you're wise. Like the sprite, this creature is born magically, spawned by the forces of Nature from a clear pool of water.

name: Summon mantis
description: Summon a number of mantises based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Despite rumors to the contrary, the giant mantis is a natural beast, and like its smaller cousin it is cold and merciless. Sure, it's difficult to believe your own eyes when you seen an insect of that size. Now, imagine fighting one!

name: Summon phoenix
description: Summon a number of phoenixes based on the level of the caster.
blurb: Whether it is a true bird or a creature of flames is undetermined. Both perhaps. Like Nature though, the phoenix never really dies. It's just stuck in an endless cycle of life and death.
notes: Ordinarily, the summoned creatures disappear once killed, but phoenixes' rebirth ability is first applied.
